author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Cangaroo is an open-source CAN bus analyzer for Linux systems used in automotive, robotics, and industrial environments. The desktop application focuses on real-time capture, decoding, and analysis of CAN and CAN-FD traffic, with native integration into the Linux SocketCAN stack. title: Cangaroo open-source CAN bus analyzer supports SocketCAN and CAN-FD on Linux
